program.name: Balance 35
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of balance: a circuit, then single-leg strength.
program.about: Balance for about half an hour. A circuit of still and moving balance, then single-leg strength in straight sets. Two sessions alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
program.split: Balance circuit & strength A / B, 35 minutes
